title: Tide-Pool Specimen Chronicle
premise: An intertidal inheritance at a seaside specimen room. Achao and Axi are easily confused; the intertidal specimen case goes intact→seawater-corroded→resealed; the glass-bottom observation boat must be avoided after it sinks; count memory, false friends, and temporal flashbacks run throughout. Human-readable context only; never fed to the SUT.
_comment: Author layer: humans only write entities + state machines + per-scene timelines (present + handwritten action + semantic events). present items may be objects carrying confusable_with/count/anchor metadata. op/gap/probe/forbidden are derived by complete_gt.py.
_state_note: Stateful entities use states; stateless entities use appearance. On transition, inject only the current state's appearance. Flashbacks may set state on a present item to point at a past state.

states.prime_on_duty: Naturalist Shen Yu in his forties, skin honey-tanned by sea wind, khaki vest and rubber boots, magnifying glass and sampling spoon at his belt.
states.weary_injured: The same Shen Yu weary and injured: vest torn, waterproof bandage on his calf, magnifying glass still at his belt, steps dragging through mud.
states.retired_away: Shen Yu has retired and departed; only his old khaki vest and name tag remain in the specimen room—he himself no longer appears.

states.youth_apprentice: Young Achao: a lean tide-pool apprentice of fourteen or fifteen, sea-green kelp cord in his hair, wet trouser cuffs, bright stubborn eyes.
states.adult_successor: Adult Achao: a sturdy successor observer in his twenties, still wearing the sea-green kelp cord, eyes steady and calm.

states.intact: An oak intertidal specimen case with intact glass lid, compartments holding starfish, limpets, and dried seaweed, labels neat.
states.seawater_corroded: The same specimen case flooded with seawater: glass lid fogged, label ink bled, compartments pooling with brine.
states.resealed: After resealing, the specimen case has clear relabeled compartments, but a pale white salt stain on one corner distinguishes it from the original intact state.

states.intact: A waterproof-cloth tide observation log, pages filled with tide-height curves and species sketches, corners clean.
states.salt_frost_damaged: The same tide observation log covered in salt frost: cover whitened and curling, writing blurred, a crumpled blotting sheet tucked inside.

states.intact: A pale-green glass-bottom observation boat, white wave lines painted on the gunwales, transparent hull for looking down into tide pools.
states.reef_wrecked: The glass-bottom observation boat reef-struck with hull shattered, half-sunk in foam among the rocks, only a listing wreck left.

states.youth_rival: Axi, face and build extremely similar to Achao, but wearing an amber conch brooch, bold and eager to dive first.
states.remade_return: Remade Axi still wears the amber conch brooch, now with dive goggles pushed up on the forehead, expression deeper and quieter.

E7.name: seaside specimen room
E7.appearance: A seaside wooden-house specimen room: sea charts and tide tables on the wall, specimen cases on a long table, breaking surf outside the window.

E8.name: rocky-shore tide pool
E8.appearance: Rocky-shore tide pools exposed at ebb tide, clear pooled water, anemones and small crabs in crevices, footing slick underfoot.

E9.name: breakwater passage
E9.appearance: A narrow passage inside the breakwater, barnacles on both walls, ankle-deep at high tide, emergency lights dim yellow.

E10.name: abandoned lighthouse base
E10.appearance: The basalt base of an abandoned lighthouse, steps crumbling, copper-green railing broken, new tide pools visible in the distance.

E11.name: basalt memorial plaque
E11.appearance: A basalt memorial plaque nailed to the lighthouse base, engraved with Shen Yu's name and years, surface crusted with salt crystals.

E12.name: glass marker buoys
E12.appearance: Three palm-sized green glass marker buoys tied in a string with hemp rope to mark fixed observation points.

E13.name: plastic tourist pedal boat
E13.appearance: A plastic tourist pedal boat, boat-shaped but with no glass bottom, hull stenciled 'Tourist'.

E14.name: Inspector Han
E14.appearance: Coastal patrol inspector Han, build somewhat resembling Shen Yu, deep-blue uniform and silver shoulder bars, cap badge an anchor—not a magnifying glass.

E15.name: specimen-cabinet spotlights
E15.appearance: A row of five small spotlights clipped to specimen cabinets, frosted white shades, numbers stamped on the metal clips.

E16.name: fog-bell hand cranks
E16.appearance: Two brass fog-bell hand cranks hung on the specimen-room lintel, low short notes when cranked.

E17.name: volunteer Xiaozhu
E17.appearance: Volunteer Xiaozhu, at a glance somewhat like young Achao, light-brown hair band instead of sea-green kelp cord, shy gaze.

E18.name: miniature display case
E18.appearance: A miniature display case, compartment layout much like the specimen case but smaller, no real labels, acrylic lid.

E19.name: orange-red rescue jet ski
E19.appearance: An unfamiliar orange-red rescue jet ski, short squat hull, no glass bottom, 'Coastal Rescue' on the side.

features.E2: Achao: sea-green kelp cord in hair, calm/stubborn eyes.
features.E6: Axi: face extremely similar to Achao, but amber conch brooch, bold or deep expression.

lookalike_pairs.note: Hard confuse sample: Achao and Axi look alike; distinguish only by kelp cord vs amber conch brooch.

scenes.setting: Seaside specimen room routine (introduce five specimen-cabinet spotlights · two fog-bell hand cranks)
actions: At dusk, Shen Yu pushes open the seaside specimen room's wooden door and sets his sampling spoon on the long table.

actions.action: A row of five specimen-cabinet spotlights clips to the cabinets; Shen Yu turns each on and wipes the shades clean.
Two brass fog-bell hand cranks hang on the lintel; Shen Yu cranks one lightly, and short notes echo through the wooden room.

actions: Shen Yu opens the intertidal specimen case and checks every starfish and limpet label.
Shen Yu gazes through the window at the darkening sea line beyond the rocky-shore tide pool.

actions.action: The intact intertidal specimen case rests at the center of the long table, glass lid reflecting the spotlight glow.

actions: Shen Yu notes today's low-tide times beside the wall chart.
Shen Yu unhooks the magnifying glass from his belt and hangs it back, checking the lens for salt haze.
Shen Yu sorts scattered sample bottles and reorders them by tide level.
Shen Yu sits in the specimen room's wicker chair and rubs shoulders stiff from sea wind.

scenes.setting: Recording the tide observation log
actions: Shen Yu opens the tide observation log and records today's tide height and water temperature.
Shen Yu sketches a newly seen anemone in the tide observation log.
Shen Yu closes the tide observation log and tucks it into a drawer.

actions.action: Glare from the intertidal specimen case glass sweeps across Shen Yu's profile.

actions: Shen Yu circles worn label compartments on the specimen case in red ink.
Shen Yu tightens the ink bottle cap and moves it away from the damp windowsill.

scenes.setting: Rocky-shore tide pool greets the apprentice (introduce three glass marker buoys)
actions: On the morning rocky-shore tide pool, Shen Yu greets young Achao as he poles the glass-bottom observation boat to shore.

actions.action: Achao jumps down from the glass-bottom observation boat and ties the hawser to a basalt spike.
Shen Yu points to the three green glass marker buoys, teaching Achao to read the fixed observation points.
Achao crouches by a tide-pool puddle, studying an anemone's tentacles with curiosity.
Shen Yu explains to Achao how current and tidal range change the species in the pool.
Achao looks back at the intact glass-bottom observation boat, eyes full of longing.
Shen Yu has Achao lean over the gunwale and peer through the glass bottom at gobies in the rock crevices.
Achao tightens his sea-green kelp cord and carefully notes the tide level Shen Yu recites.

scenes.setting: Breakwater passage (Axi alone)
actions: In the breakwater passage, Axi wearing an amber conch brooch glances back from behind the barnacle wall.
Axi strides through ankle-deep water in the passage, boldly swinging a net bag.
Axi brushes past a bucket-carrying fisherman; the amber conch brooch sways under the emergency light.
Axi stops at the passage mouth, critiquing the handwriting on a temporary observation sign.
Axi kicks a loose barnacle shell into the water.
Axi crosses the passage and vanishes into the surf beyond the breakwater.

scenes.setting: Rocky-shore tide pool: Achao and Axi co-present
actions: At the rocky-shore tide pool, Achao and Axi stand side by side—one with sea-green kelp cord, one with amber conch brooch.
Achao hands Axi a small limpet he found; the two look at each other with different expressions.
Axi straightens Achao's kelp cord and deliberately rattles her brooch.
Achao and Axi walk slowly along the pool edge, footprints overlapping then parting on wet sand.
Achao checks a sketch while Axi jumps into a deeper puddle.
Achao and Axi part at the pool mouth, each walking opposite ways.

scenes.setting: Seaside specimen room (tide observation log salt-frost damaged)
actions: Months later at night, Shen Yu keeps watch alone in the specimen room; the intertidal specimen case sits quietly on the table.

actions.action: Shen Yu opens the tide observation log and finds the cover salt-frosted white, writing blurred.

actions: Shen Yu wipes water fog from the intertidal specimen case glass lid.
Shen Yu gazes through the window at the black tide pool and distant lights.

actions.action: Spotlight pools drift slowly across the intertidal specimen case glass.

actions: Shen Yu slips blotting paper into the damaged tide observation log, sighs, and turns off the light.

scenes.setting: Spring-tide week observation (filler)
actions: On a spring-tide week morning, Shen Yu marks the highest tide on the wall chart.
Shen Yu moves fragile specimens into an inner cabinet.
Shen Yu rinses salt crystals from the sampling spoon with fresh water.
Shen Yu checks the intertidal specimen case, verifying each starfish arm is intact.
In the afternoon, Shen Yu takes a coastal patrol call in the specimen room, brow furrowed.
Shen Yu writes 'Hold off diving' on a note and tapes it to the door.
Shen Yu reorders sample bottles and pulls deep-water samples aside.

scenes.setting: Species-registration fortnight (filler)
actions: During species-registration fortnight, Shen Yu spreads tracing paper beside the intertidal specimen case.
Shen Yu marks new limpet sites with orange dots.
Shen Yu weights the tracing-paper edges with stones.
Shen Yu tries to read old numbers in the salt-frost-damaged tide observation log.
Shen Yu moves his teacup farther away, afraid of splashing the pages again.
Shen Yu lists three observation routes to adjust on the wall.
Waves grow louder outside; Shen Yu pauses and listens.

scenes.setting: Rocky-shore patrol day (filler · no marker buoys)
actions: On rocky-shore patrol day, Shen Yu puts on a straw hat and walks into the tide-pool zone.
Shen Yu probes slick rock with a bamboo staff.
Shen Yu notes where tourists kicked apart a stone pile.
Shen Yu shines a flashlight into a deep puddle.
Shen Yu talks briefly with fishermen at the breakwater mouth.
Shen Yu avoids sharp oyster shells and circles to the far side of the pool.
Shen Yu measures the width of a newly collapsed rock crevice with a tape measure.

scenes.setting: Rocky-shore tide pool patrol (recall glass marker buoys · plastic tourist pedal boat false friend)
actions: At dawn, Shen Yu patrols the rocky-shore tide pool; the glass-bottom observation boat moors in the shallow bay.

actions.action: Shen Yu crouches to inspect scratches on the glass-bottom observation boat hull.
Shen Yu walks to the rock spike; those three green glass marker buoys are still tied in place.
A plastic tourist pedal boat stenciled 'Tourist' crosses the shallow bay—no glass bottom, nothing like the observation boat.
Shen Yu stands at the tide-pool edge, recording rock crevices exposed after the ebb.
Shen Yu retightens the glass-bottom observation boat hawser.
Shen Yu confirms again that none of the three glass marker buoys is missing.
Shen Yu writes the patrol date on the wooden sign at the pool mouth.

scenes.setting: Pre-storm standby (filler)
actions: On the eve of the storm, Shen Yu stows all window-side charts in cabinets.
Shen Yu covers the intertidal specimen case with waterproof cloth against damp and spray.
Shen Yu checks that the tide observation log is in a dry drawer.
Shen Yu tightens the ink bottle cap and moves it higher.
Distant thunder rolls; specimen-room lights flicker once.
Shen Yu untangles the five specimen-cabinet spotlight cords.
Shen Yu drafts a 'Testing suspended tomorrow' notice on the door.

scenes.setting: Storm night (specimen case corroded · observation boat sunk)
actions: The storm rises suddenly; the specimen-room roof leaks and brine splashes the desktop.
A draft lifts tracing paper; the intertidal specimen case clasp pops open.

actions.action: Seawater floods the case; the intertidal specimen case glass fogs and label ink bleeds.
In the shallow bay, the glass-bottom observation boat pitches hard in giant waves.
Hidden reef tears the hull; the glass-bottom observation boat half-sinks in foam among the rocks.
In the specimen room, Shen Yu lunges for the long table and presses down on the flooding intertidal specimen case.
Shattered glass cuts Shen Yu's calf; blood seeps through the waterproof bandage as he still shields the case.
The corroding intertidal specimen case slowly beads with moisture in the damp air.

scenes.setting: After the disaster (observation boat indirect reference · spotlight recall)

actions.action: The day after the storm, Shen Yu stands in the seaside specimen room, staring at the seawater-corroded intertidal specimen case.
Shen Yu runs a finger over salt stains on the intertidal specimen case, face dark.
Beside the anomaly column, Shen Yu clips a wreck note marking the date the glass-bottom observation boat reef-wrecked.
An old photo taken through the glass bottom still hangs on the wall—gobies in the rock crevices; Shen Yu gazes a long time.
Shen Yu turns on one of the five specimen-cabinet spotlights and sits alone in its pool of light.
The damaged intertidal specimen case still sits on the table, glass fog in plain sight.
Shen Yu changes the blood-soaked bandage and keeps clearing shattered glass.
Shen Yu covers everything again with waterproof cloth, afraid damp will reach the intertidal specimen case once more.

scenes.setting: Cleanup and funding request (filler)
actions: During cleanup week, Shen Yu packs shattered glass into cardboard boxes.
Shen Yu submits a funding request to the coastal patrol station for sealing materials.
Shen Yu still comes to the specimen room daily, staring at the corroded intertidal specimen case.
Shen Yu traces still-legible labels onto transparent paper in pencil.
Shen Yu turns the damaged tide observation log to a blank page and logs funding progress instead.
Achao is on leave and has not returned; only Shen Yu's footsteps echo in the specimen room.
Shen Yu habitually touches the empty mooring spike where the boat once tied.
Shen Yu lists supplies needed for resealing on the wall.

scenes.setting: Resealing (third state · miniature display case false friend)
actions: Weeks later, Shen Yu brings silicone and new labels and begins resealing the intertidal specimen case.

actions.action: Shen Yu takes a miniature display case from a cardboard box—it closely resembles the specimen case but is smaller, with no real labels.

actions: Shen Yu carefully drains pooled water, relabels compartments, and seals the glass lid.

actions.action: The last silicone bead dries; the intertidal specimen case is resealed, a pale white salt stain on one corner.

actions: The resealed intertidal specimen case is readable again under the light; Shen Yu watches it with relief.

actions.action: Shen Yu pushes the miniature display case aside and centers the true intertidal specimen case on the salt-stain alignment line.
The specimen room falls quiet; the resealed intertidal specimen case alone occupies the center of the long table.

scenes.setting: False friends: rescue jet ski and Inspector Han

actions.action: An orange-red rescue jet ski enters the shallow bay, nothing like the long-sunk glass-bottom observation boat.
Coastal patrol Inspector Han with silver shoulder bars walks the rocky shore and talks beside Shen Yu; the two are similar in build.
Inspector Han points at the orange-red rescue jet ski, explaining the new patrol sector to Shen Yu.
The jet ski sounds its horn and leaves; Shen Yu alone on the rocky-shore tide pool watches it go.
The orange-red rescue jet ski pauses briefly at the far breakwater head, then moves on.
Before leaving, Inspector Han claps Shen Yu's shoulder; the anchor cap badge flashes under the light.

scenes.setting: False friend: volunteer Xiaozhu resembles Achao

actions.action: At the rocky-shore tide pool comes volunteer Xiaozhu with a light-brown hair band—at a glance somewhat like young Achao.
Xiaozhu tries to tie a hawser; Shen Yu shakes his head—she is not Achao after all.
Xiaozhu shyly asks whether anemones are poisonous; Shen Yu answers briefly and sends her to help in the specimen room.
Shen Yu alone on the rocky shore stares at the empty mooring spike.

scenes.setting: Calm fortnight after resealing (filler)
actions: The first fortnight after resealing, Shen Yu checks the intertidal specimen case clasp every morning.
Shen Yu logs new labels on blank pages of the damaged tide observation log.
Shen Yu refuses to leave ink on the windowsill again.
Shen Yu checks no-harvest zone notices with fishermen.
Shen Yu practices steadier sampling technique in the specimen room.
Afternoon sun through the wooden window falls on the resealed intertidal specimen case.
Shen Yu polishes the fog-bell hand cranks but does not crank them yet.
Shen Yu receives a postcard from Achao and leaves it unopened under a spotlight base.

scenes.setting: Year-end accounts (filler)
actions: At year-end closing, Shen Yu binds tracing paper by month.
Shen Yu puts the salt-frost-damaged tide observation log alone into an archive sleeve.
Shen Yu prints before-and-after resealing photos and clips them into the archive.
Shen Yu clears the long table, leaving only magnifying glass and one spotlight.
Shen Yu oils the sampling spoon thinly against rust.
Shen Yu signs a date beside the intertidal specimen case salt stain.
Fine snow falls outside; the specimen-room stove hums softly.
Shen Yu finishes the annual summary; the cover bears only the word 'Tide Pool'.

scenes.setting: Twilight years (Shen Yu weary-injured state · long-range fog-bell recall)

actions.action: Years later at dusk, Shen Yu with a scarred calf and heavy steps leans on a bamboo staff at the abandoned lighthouse base.

actions: Shen Yu looks up at the broken copper-green railing, gaze distant.

actions.action: Beside the base, the two brass fog-bell hand cranks he brought back hang on a stone pillar, chiming softly in the wind.

actions: Shen Yu presses a palm to the basalt base as if saying goodbye.

actions.action: Shen Yu slowly sits on the crumbling steps and catches his breath.
The two fog-bell hand cranks chime again; Shen Yu closes his eyes and listens, as if hearing the old fog alert. (fog-bell hand cranks visible)

scenes.setting: Old-site wandering fortnight (filler)
actions: Shen Yu still returns to the specimen room daily but spends more time sitting and watching the intertidal specimen case.
Shen Yu leans his bamboo staff by the door; he moves slower than before.
Shen Yu has a young assistant write the tide chart while he only checks.
Shen Yu sends Achao photos of the resealed intertidal specimen case.
Shen Yu writes 'Handover' on the last page of the damaged tide observation log but leaves no signature.
Shen Yu refuses hospitalization and insists on sitting at the lighthouse base each week.
Shen Yu polishes a draft of the basalt memorial plaque.
At night the specimen room keeps only one light; Shen Yu dozes inside its circle.

scenes.setting: Achao returns · Shen Yu's farewell

actions.action: In daylight, adult Achao returns along the abandoned lighthouse base and walks quickly toward the steps.

actions: Achao reunites with slow-stepping Shen Yu at the base; the two embrace.

actions.action: Beside the cot in the specimen room, Achao holds Shen Yu's thin hand.
Shen Yu's breath fades; he finally closes his eyes and passes away.
Achao stands long at the lighthouse base, tears falling on salt crystals.
Achao hangs Shen Yu's magnifying glass at his own belt.

scenes.setting: Relics · memorial plaque (indirect reference to the deceased)

actions.action: Behind the specimen-room door still hangs Shen Yu's old khaki sampling vest, magnifying-glass cord peeking from the pocket; Achao touches it gently.
Beside the lighthouse base, adult Achao stands before the newly nailed basalt memorial plaque.
Achao's fingertips trace the name Shen Yu carved on the basalt memorial plaque.
Achao places a white chrysanthemum at the lower edge of the basalt memorial plaque.
Wind crosses the base; Achao quietly reads the year on the plaque.

scenes.setting: Achao and Axi reunited (adult confuse + co-present)

actions.action: Adult Axi with dive goggles pushed up on her forehead hurries from beyond the breakwater and embraces Achao tightly at the lighthouse base.

actions: Achao and Axi stand side by side beside the memorial plaque—one calm-eyed, one deep-eyed.
Axi touches her amber conch brooch and glances at the magnifying glass on Achao's belt.
The two look at each other in silence, studying faces alike yet different.
Achao and Axi walk together toward the far tide pool, shadows merging into one.

scenes.setting: Temporal flashback (timeline anchor · no personal names throughout)

actions.action: The camera returns years ago—the boy with sea-green cord in his hair who jumped from the small boat appears again at the tide pool.

anchor.phrase: Boy with sea-green cord at the tide pool

actions.action: The opening moment returns—in the specimen room, a compartmented oak glass case is placed on the long table for the first time.

anchor.phrase: Compartmented oak glass case first placed on the long table at the opening

actions.action: Flash back to the breakwater passage that year—the figure with amber conch brooch swinging a net bag flashes past.

anchor.phrase: Figure with amber conch brooch in the passage that year

actions.action: Before the eyes rises that row of five old lamps with frosted shades on the specimen cabinets.

anchor.phrase: That row of five old lamps on the specimen cabinets

actions.action: Return to the rocky-shore puddle at first meeting—anemone tentacles unchanged as ever.

anchor.phrase: Rocky-shore puddle at first meeting after the ebb

actions.action: Pages turn—the waterproof-cloth log with tide curves and no salt frost yet appears again.

scenes._comment: Temporal flashback uses no entity personal names throughout; anchor.resolves_to is for scoring.

scenes.setting: Closure (long-range damaged log · long-range marker buoys)

actions.action: Achao reopens the salt-frost-damaged tide observation log and walks into the seaside specimen room.
On the specimen-room counter, those three green glass marker buoys are still tied in a string.
Achao takes up watch over the intertidal specimen case; the corner salt stain is clear under the light.
Achao turns on all five specimen-cabinet spotlights; light fills the long table again.
Achao stands straight before the resealed intertidal specimen case and checks labels and salt stain compartment by compartment, as Shen Yu once did.
